answer: The opal schedule is applied in orchard and knoll reveals each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 26% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1800 identities would post 962 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
